protocol.precision: float64; fixed confidence mask; reference RMS radius
protocol.gain_definition: Worst weighted target RMS / unweighted source point RMS, over coordinate directions; overlapping regions are not a partition
protocol.noise_assumption: Independent isotropic coordinate noise with unit variance, a sensitivity diagnostic only; confidence is not a calibrated probability
protocol.selection: Predeclared diagnostic ablations; known single-source development labels; no candidate selection, threshold calibration or statistical acceptance

scope: Reuses real extracted coordinates; perturbations and fit ablations do not rerun the detector or validate GPU generation, pose robustness or recovery
